# Partial Differential Equations

Differential operators, boundary conditions, and forcing determine a PDE problem.
Laplace and Poisson equations provide examples of Green's functions and spectral
solution methods. On the sphere, spherical harmonics connect these ideas to the
Laplace-Beltrami operator.

The [spectral methods chapter](spectral-methods.qmd) develops projection,
Gaussian quadrature, spherical harmonic transforms, elliptic inversion, and
nonlinear dealiasing.
